mapper.select: SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) id,merchant_id,name,description,status,version FROM product WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) id,merchant_id,name,description,status,version FROM product WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) id,merchant_id,name,description,status,version FROM product WHERE (#{merchantId} IS NULL AND status='ON_SALE') OR merchant_id=#{merchantId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE (#{merchantId} IS NULL AND status='ON_SALE') OR merchant_id=#{merchantId}
SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) id,merchant_id,name,description,status,version FROM product ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT CAST(s.id AS CHAR) id,CAST(s.product_id AS CHAR) product_id,s.sku_code,s.specification,s.price_cents,s.price_version,s.status,s.version,p.merchant_id,p.status product_status FROM sku s JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE s.product_id=#{productId} ORDER BY s.id

SELECT CAST(s.id AS CHAR) id,CAST(s.product_id AS CHAR) product_id,s.sku_code,s.specification,s.price_cents,s.price_version,s.status,s.version,p.merchant_id,p.status product_status FROM sku s JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE s.id=#{id}

SELECT CAST(s.id AS CHAR) id,CAST(s.product_id AS CHAR) product_id,s.sku_code,s.specification,s.price_cents,s.price_version,s.status,s.version,p.merchant_id,p.status product_status FROM sku s JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE s.id=#{id} FOR SHARE
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET name=#{name},description=#{description},status=#{status},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND version=#{version}
UPDATE sku SET price_version=price_version+IF(price_cents<>#{priceCents},1,0),price_cents=#{priceCents},status=#{status},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT available_qty,reserved_qty FROM inventory WHERE warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} AND sku_id=#{skuId}
SELECT available_qty,reserved_qty FROM inventory WHERE warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} AND sku_id=#{skuId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory SET available_qty=available_qty+#{delta},version=version+1 WHERE warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} AND sku_id=#{skuId} AND available_qty+#{delta}>=0 AND available_qty+reserved_qty+#{delta}<=1000000000
mapper.select: SELECT l.business_no,CAST(l.sku_id AS CHAR) sku_id,l.operation_type,l.available_delta,l.reserved_delta,l.available_after,l.reserved_after,l.created_at FROM inventory_ledger l JOIN sku s ON s.id=l.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE p.merchant_id=#{merchantId} ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_ledger l JOIN sku s ON s.id=l.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE p.merchant_id=#{merchantId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO idempotency_request(actor_type,actor_id,operation,idempotency_key,request_hash,business_no) VALUES(#{actorType},#{actorId},#{operation},#{idempotencyKey},#{requestHash},#{businessNo}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT request_hash,state,business_no,result_snapshot FROM idempotency_request WHERE actor_type=#{actorType} AND actor_id=#{actorId} AND operation=#{operation} AND idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey} FOR UPDATE

choose.when: SELECT merchant_id FROM inventory_receipt WHERE receipt_no=#{businessNo} AND receipt_no=JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(#{snapshot},'$.businessNo'))

SELECT p.merchant_id FROM inventory_condition_operation o JOIN sku s ON s.id=o.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE o.operation_no=#{businessNo} AND o.operation_no=JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(#{snapshot},'$.operationNo')) AND CAST(o.sku_id AS CHAR)=JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(#{snapshot},'$.skuId'))

mapper.update: UPDATE idempotency_request SET state='SUCCEEDED',result_code='OK',result_snapshot=#{resultSnapshot},version=version+1 WHERE actor_type=#{actorType} AND actor_id=#{actorId} AND operation=#{operation} AND idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}
